method: 60 Hz production Game.step; seeded randomness and fixed daytime for reproducibility. Damage/TTK calibration uses stationary non-attacking targets, actual collisions, durations and cooldowns. Ordinary full set at legal hero level; remaining points legally assigned to Speed. Boss TTK is a stationary lower bound with Super Strength resistance, not a boss AI victory. Ideal combat XP/min excludes travel/respawn and is not a measured farming rate. Patrol starts a legal-level fixture on an actual four-monster second-tier platform in its appropriate region, then uses only input commands with full AI/respawn/XP until ten minutes or defeat. No teleporting or invulnerability during measurement. It is a limited bot, not a human progression forecast.
unavailable: Hero level 1 earns no Power Points; upgrades above heroLevel-1 are omitted.
